simple.summary: שִׁנְעָר (Shinʻâr) means Shinar , a plain in Babylonia First listed occurrence: Dan 1 2.

definitions.full: H8152. Shinar שִׁנְעָר proper name, of a location Shinar = Babylonia (= Babylonian Šumêr according to COT Gen 11:1 and others, > denied by Hal Rev. Crit. 1883, 44 Jen ZK ii(1885), 419 ; Egyptian Sangar (WMM As.u.Eur.279 ), Tel Amarna Šan—ar (Wkl TelAm. 25 ) identification with ׳שׁ by Mey Egyptiaca 63 ; compare, further, Pinches Hast. DB SHINAR ); — שׁ ׳אֶרֶץ 10:10 ; 11:2 ; Zech 5:11 ; Dan 1:2 ; ׳מֶלֶךְשֿׁ (Amraphel) Gen 14:2 , 9 ; ׳שׁ alone Isa 11:11 (as place of diaspora); שׁ ׳אַדֶּרֶת Josh 7:21 ; ᵐ5 usually Σεν ( ν ) ααρ ; Zech 5:11 ( ἐν γῆ ) Βαβυλῶνος . שְׁנָת sleep , see שֵׁנָה below יָשֵׁן .
